scope_summary: Social Groups in SplitBill (frontend): associate a GoPay group with a split, auto-create groups, group-initiated splits with post-back extensions, one-split participant add/remove without mutating the group, non-member invite opt-in, group recommendations with client-side ordering, create-group-from-split, in-group split activity widget (borrower/lender/non-participant), grouped split history/details, and BAU payment settlement. Gated by Litmus flag feature_split_bill_groups. Android + iOS, Indonesia. Only PRD and RFC contexts were provided (no design_context or plan_context).
risk_assessment: R1 (High): concurrent member selection during slow group-info fetch can leave ambiguous association state; resolved state is OQ5 (open).
R2 (High): invites are fire-and-forget/queued; a screen dismissal must not cancel them and must not block split completion.
R3 (Medium): client-owned recommendation ordering/pinning is complex; incorrect top-slot pinning across entry paths.
R4 (Medium): recommendation caching mechanism is TBD (OQ4); risk of stale group/recommendation data within TTL.
R5 (Medium): >25-member threshold mishandling can wrongly associate/omit a group.
R6 (Low): only one group per split; second-group guard can drift if bypassed.
R7 (Medium): loader/error designs pending for several bottomsheets and the gopay-users fetch failure (OQ7) - those paths are blocked.
R8 (Medium): recommendation-API error suppression logic must show/hide errors exactly per the selected-group rule.
Feature-flag drift: PRD feature_key 'split_bill_gopay_groups' does not match RFC Litmus key 'feature_split_bill_groups' (RFC match:false).
PII: group/member payloads carry encrypted_phone_number and encrypted gopay_account_id; pending-invitee identity must be masked to non-inviters.

prd_vs_figma_gaps.gap_description: design_context.json was not provided; PRD context_screens (e.g. Participant selection, Split bill details, In-group split activity widget) could not be validated against Figma frames, and no element IDs are available for locator handoff.

prd_vs_rfc_gaps.gap_description: Feature-flag key mismatch: PRD uses feature_key 'split_bill_gopay_groups' while the RFC Litmus toggle is 'feature_split_bill_groups' (RFC prd_cross_refs match:false, Medium drift). Tests must gate on the RFC key.

Auto-group-creation trigger drift: PRD says a group is auto-created when a split has more than 2 members; RFC says auto-creation happens when there are no groups in the recommended section (create_social_group flag on the create API, backend-to-backend). The trigger condition differs between contexts.

Group >25 handling drift: PRD says >25 groups are 'shown disabled for selection'; RFC says >25 groups are 'not selected by default and associated only if a member is selected from manage-participation'. Both behaviors are tested; the canonical rule needs confirmation.
Analytics drift: PRD SB-G11 implies group-association visibility/telemetry, but RFC analytics events are pending on Product (OQ3). No clickstream events defined; telemetry tests not generated.
RFC prd_cross_refs requirement_refs omit SB-G9 (payment request settlement) and SB-G12 (M2 reminders); these PRD requirements are not explicitly reflected in the RFC scope.

rfc_vs_impl_plan_gaps.gap_description: plan_context.json was not provided; RFC architectural risks (R1-R8), cache strategy, lifecycle handling (BACKGROUND_FOREGROUND, PROCESS_DEATH), and READ_CONTACTS permission could not be validated against implementation screens touched, view-models, or declared test hooks.
N-1 / minimum-supported-app-version behavior is undocumented (min_supported_app_version and min_os_version null). Only the Litmus flag is stated as fallback; N-1 regression scope cannot be finalized.

missing_hooks: plan_context.json not provided - no declared test hooks (deeplink / flag-override / state-injection) available; navigation currently relies on full UI walks except the Social Group Details deeplink.
No deep link for the Select Member Page (RFC navigation_changes deep_link:null); group-initiated entry passes social_group_id but has no addressable deep link.
No hook to deterministically force recommendation-API failure vs success, slow group-info fetch, or invite/create-group API failure for R1/R2/R7/R8 paths.
locator_readiness_checklist: design_context.json not provided - no logical element tokens or per-platform locators (android_resource_id / ios_accessibility_identifier) exist for any screen. element_locator_handoff is empty until design/dev supply them.
Toasts, bottomsheets (manage-participation, 'select group or create new'), and the in-group activity widget need stable accessibility IDs before automation.
unclear_ac: OQ1: Will the recommendations API return member data directly for <25-member groups, or is a separate group-info call required? Affects loader/error paths.
OQ2: Group recommendation API contract is pending from CX - contract-level tests cannot be authored yet.
OQ3: Analytics/clickstream events pending on Product - no telemetry verification generated. Are clickstream events required for this feature?
OQ4: Recommendation caching mechanism undecided (network 10-min TTL vs on-module Cache Store) - cache freshness/TTL scenarios blocked.
OQ5: Resolved state when a member is selected during a group-member fetch that changes the recommendation is undefined.
OQ6: Do update-draft and split bill details social_group payloads need member lists? Affects contract tests.

OQ7: Loader/error designs pending for the manage-participation bottomsheet, 'select group or create new' bottomsheet, and gopay-users fetch failure - those error paths are blocked (only recommendation-API failure UX is ready).
OQ8: N-1 / min supported app & OS versions undefined.
SB-G7 (historical splits): design for historical split bill group handling and for group edition from split-bill flows is pending (PRD §5.8) - no assertable behavior, no scenario generated.
SB-G8 (deeplink/PN): social deeplink target and PN/Genie destination (split bill details vs social group page) undecided - no scenario generated.
SB-G12 (M2): in-group reminders are candidate scope, not committed - excluded from this plan.
